title: Activation sprint checklist and consequence matrix for alpha cluster
creator: Avery Chen
description: Prepare an end-to-end activation sprint checklist and a consequence matrix for the alpha cluster of lighthouse customers. The goal is to unify launch gate decisions, coordinate release notes and support resources, and define immediate remediation actions for common failure modes so engineering, support, and sales can operate with a single decisioning artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Single-page activation checklist covering pre-launch, D-1, D0, and post-launch windows
Consequence matrix enumerating 8 high-likelihood failure modes with owners and SLAs
Release notes coordination timeline and templates agreed by Docs, Eng, and CS
Feedback loop defined with automated telemetry hooks and a weekly triage cadence
Stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng Lead, Design Lead, Support Manager) recorded in Confluence
plan: Draft checklist and consequence matrix: PM + Eng lead (2 days)
Review with Design and Support for UX and customer-facing language (1 day)
Iterate with Docs to create release notes template and versioning guideline (1 day)
Integrate telemetry hooks: add eval and alert runbooks to SRE (3 days)
Finalize and circulate, collect formal sign-offs (2 days)
timeline: 2025-02-27: Final doc published and sign-offs captured
2025-03-05: Dry run with alpha cluster (simulated traffic)
2025-03-12: Target go/no-go decision and launch window
rollout_steps: Pre-launch: validate customer onboarding scripts and sample prompts
D-1: run synthetic load test, validate KV cache warmup, confirm autoscaling targets
D0 morning: enable verbose telemetry, route alpha traffic through canary policies
D0 afternoon: monitor SLOs for 2 hours, if degradation > 15% follow consequence matrix
Post-launch day 1: rollback window open for 6 hours, scheduled incremental rollout thereafter
release_notes_coordination: Docs to produce: high-level feature summary, known limitations, migration notes
Template: TL;DR, change list, behavioral impacts, troubleshooting steps, contact channels
Versioning rule: include model spec name + runtime-flag (example: gpt-open-3.4-runtime-1.18)
Owner matrix: Docs writes, Eng validates technical accuracy, Support approves contact flows
Delivery: release notes emailed to alpha cohort and posted in private portal 2 hours before D0
feedback_loop: Capture: central feedback thread + structured form linked in portal
Telemetry: sampling of requests flagged for semantic regressions; embedding-based clustering of failure cases
Triage cadence: daily standup for first 72 hours, then weekly review for 4 weeks
Action types: immediate rollback, hotfix PR, prompt template update, docs clarification
Customer communication SLA: acknowledge within 4 hours for high-impact reports
metrics_and_success_criteria: Stability: 99.5% success rate on alpha traffic during 24-hour launch window
Latency: p95 <= 700ms for gen endpoints under alpha traffic profile
Quality: semantic regression rate <= 2% on monitored eval prompt set
Adoption: 60% of alpha accounts complete onboarding flow within 7 days
Feedback resolution: 80% of P0/P1 issues closed or mitigated within 72 hours
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected model regression post-deploy -> Mitigation: immediate fallback to prior model variant + open rollback playbook
Risk: Support overload -> Mitigation: temporary escalation channel + on-call rotation augmentation
Risk: Release notes inaccuracies -> Mitigation: mandatory Eng validation and dry-run of docs against sample responses
Risk: Autoscaler misconfiguration -> Mitigation: pre-launch dry runs and conservative burst limits
tasks: PM: finalize checklist and publish Confluence doc (PM-45877-1)
Eng: add telemetry tags and alert rules for alpha cohort (ENG-21044)
Docs: produce release notes template and pre-announce message (DOC-992)
SRE: run dry synthetic load tests and validate autoscale policies (INF-778)
Support: prepare canned responses and escalation playbook (CS-134)
Sales: confirm alpha customer contact list and communication windows (GTM-56)
